summary: The Barbara Bush Branch Library urges the FCC to maintain E‑Rate funding to preserve essential internet services for the community.

claims.argument: E‑Rate funding is critical for libraries to provide reliable internet, digital literacy, and essential services to underserved residents.
claims.evidence_quote: reliable internet access year after year because of E-Rate. Without E-Rate funding, we will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain the internet service our community
